notes.d3_scope: D3 (top1_presented) has ONLY rung=-1 pooled hit/miss observations in items_top1.jsonl / features_top1.csv. There are no D3 R1/R2/R3 items, so the requested D3 per-rung R1-R3 estimand is unavailable and is NOT claimed here. All D3 numbers below are pooled (rung=-1) hit-vs-miss.
notes.gold_indicator: is_gold is a construction/label artefact: in the pre-registered items answerable (rung 0) items always present the gold paragraph and rung 1-4 negatives never do, so is_gold is a deterministic function of the label. AUROC=1.0 with is_gold is tautological and cannot exculpate the gate; it quantifies the confound named by MF-7.
